Desc_303.cn: 无量金刚宗大肆追杀劫掠西域僧人，凡有窝藏僧人或隐其形迹的百姓，一并捉拿杀害。西方腥风血雨，一时人心惶惶…

Desc_330.en: Recently, giant eagles are often seen circling above Taiwu Village. They seem to hunt nearby, leaving the Dark Owl wounded by their attacks...

Desc_331.en: Recently, howls and eerie cries are often heard near Taiwu Village. Savage beasts seem to roam the area, leaving the White Deer restless.
